newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: SMC unit to renew 1 bln peso debt permit.
newsitem.headline: SMC unit to renew 1 bln peso debt permit.

text.p: San Miguel Properties Philippines Inc (SMPPI), a unit of San Miguel Corp (SMC), on Monday sought the renewal of a permit to issue to one billion pesos worth of long-term commercial papers.

In its renewal application submitted to the Securities and Exchange Commission, SMPPI said proceeds of the issue will be used to finance project development costs, investment and landbanking activities.
SMPPI has forged an underwriting agreement with the FEB Investments Inc to handle the 1 billion peso issue.
As of end 1995, SMPPI had total assets of 3.4 billion pesosn and total liabilities amounting to 1.58 billion pesos. The company posted a net income of 420.65 million pesos for the full year 1995.
